VERDICT: ACCEPT
Inspected candidate 354787921737dcf57e76d93f1e4aa1e550273ef8 in independent pass 1 with HEAD confirmed and the full diff, touched files, spec and tests reviewed; per-criterion verdicts: AC-1 satisfied (src/math.mjs:69-74, test/math.test.mjs:85-90, independent probes), R-1 satisfied (src/math.mjs:69-71), R-2 satisfied (src/math.mjs:72-74), R-3 satisfied (src/math.mjs:1-66 and test/math.test.mjs:1-83 preserved except permitted import at line 3, verified against base), R-4 satisfied (package.json:1 unchanged and only the two intended files differ), R-5 satisfied (test/math.test.mjs:85,88 both names begin min).
Finding LOW at test/math.test.mjs:88: the added tests omit invalid-element and nonmutation assertions, leaving these explicit requirements without persistent regression coverage although the implementation passes independent probes; smallest verification is adding min-prefixed tests rejecting a string element, NaN and Infinity and asserting an unsorted input remains unchanged.
Checks run: node --test --test-name-pattern="^min" test/ exited 0 with "tests 2", "pass 2", "fail 0"; npm test exited 1 with "tests 17", "pass 16", "fail 1" and only "clamp respects upper bound" failing at test/math.test.mjs:14 (15 !== 10), as expected and unchanged; read-only node -e probes printed "Independent AC-1 probes: PASS (shape, empty, invalid elements, sparse array, finite values, frozen input/nonmutation)" and "R-3 byte preservation: PASS (existing source and tests except line-3 import)"; the initial heredoc probe could not start because the sandbox prohibited its temporary file, so the same checks ran successfully inline without writes; git status remained clean, no files changed, no required check remains unavailable, and remaining uncertainty is limited to the missing persistent test coverage above.
